The Lab/2019

Karma

2019 · Apps & tools

My dashboard for finding freelance opportunities on Reddit.

Dates & sources

The surviving repository commit is dated 8 October 2019, with a migration file dated July 2019. The source names the forhire, DesignJobs and jobbit communities.

I built Karma to collect posts from freelance-job communities on Reddit and read them in one place. It filtered out some listings, linked back to the original posts, and let me hide ones I wasn’t interested in.

The dashboard and collection code survive. I’d started an analyzer, but its scoring was still a placeholder.
